Harm = a callback the reader can't locate without knowing file position. Two candidates: L25 'The closing lecture ended with a three-phrase benediction: "You know how to test..."' and L27 'The closer's Ramp paragraph attributed a framing... "the harness was the bottleneck, not the model."' — both name the source by its content, unpacked in the same sentence, matching the rule's own passing example ('the opening lecture's infinite chameleon: the LLM that flatters you'). Neither uses a bare positional pointer ('the opening lecture said above'). No other cross-file mention in body.

Harm = a slide with no self-carrying claim. All 6 chunks carry a multi-paragraph developed unit and close on their own frame: chunk1 (L9-13, the tally) closes with 'Those numbers are the story' (L13); chunk3 (the generalisation) closes with 'A rule in context is not a rule in the output' (L41); none is a bare wait-state or single context-dependent bullet.

Harm = a header the chunk's own content contradicts. Checked all 5 `##` headers against their bodies: 'The numbers'(L9)->the tallies; 'Things that went sideways'(L15)->the six-item failure catalogue; 'The generalisation'(L31)->the drawn thesis; 'Then I compounded the session'(L43)->the second-loop fix; 'What the loop is for'(L51)->states the loop's purpose. All true summaries of their chunk; none contradicted.

Per sub-item: 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' - only one 'Not' construction in body, L5 'Not the pedagogy of it. The actual session.' - single Not, not the banned two-Not triple. Anaphora/epistrophe triples - two chains found: L39 'The loop caught what the subagents missed. I caught what the loop missed. You will catch what I missed.' and L59 'I fixed what I caught. The loop caught what I missed. A senior-persona sim caught what the loop missed.' - both have a third leg introducing a new concrete agent (the reader in the first, the senior-persona sim in the second), satisfying the rule's own exception ('third leg carries NEW concrete content'). Self-grading superlatives - grep for best/greatest/most/useful move -> 0 hits in body. Number+retraction - 'Twenty-odd', 'Four banned-word leaks', 'Ten fixes' are stated flatly, no retraction language, no maintainer attestation needed. Abstraction-noun stacks - none found (L21 'post-training preferring warmth over directness' is a labeled owned inference per the backing block, not an abstraction-stack). Verb triplets with an empty leg - none found.
